run_evaluate_submission: run the evaluate script to calculate accuracy of a CIFAR-10 submission file against test data
run_load_test_data: run the load_test_data function to load the CIFAR-10 test split from the Hugging Face datasets library
run_load_submission: run the load_submission function to read a submission CSV file into a pandas DataFrame
run_evaluate_accuracy: run the evaluate_submission function to compute accuracy between true labels and predicted labels
review_evaluate_cli: review the evaluate.py CLI module that accepts a --submission_file argument and prints accuracy as JSON
